    Modify the default values of the CheckrefR environment

    checkrefr_set_defaults.Rd

    Modifies one or more internal variables of the CheckrefR environment (.checkrefr_env), used as default values by other functions of the package (Docker connection, remote connection, OpenAlex matching parameters, DOI parameters, etc.).

    Usage

    checkrefr_set_defaults(...)

    Arguments

    ...

    Named arguments corresponding to the variables to modify. Available variables, grouped by category:

    Connection / Docker

    • docker_port (character) — Local port used for the GROBID Docker container. Default: "8070".

    • docker_image (character) — Base name of the GROBID Docker image (before adding the version tag). Default: "lfoppiano/grobid:".

    • grobid_version (character) — GROBID version to use for the Docker tag. Default: "0.9.0".

    • grobid_model_type (character or NA) — Variant of the GROBID model ("crf" or "full"). An empty string, NULL or NA are normalized to NA_character_. Default: NA.

    Remote connection

    • remote_default_url (list) — Structure nested by model type. Must be a named list with at most two keys "crf" and "full", each associated with a character vector of URLs, or a list named by rank to control the trial priority. Entries not mentioned (crf or full) remain unchanged. Examples:

      • list(crf = c("https://mon-serveur-crf.example.com"))

      • list(full = list("1" = "https://mon-serveur-full.example.com"))

    • timeout (integer) — Default timeout (in seconds) for HTTP requests to the GROBID API. Default: 120L.

    Batch processing

    • max_workers (integer) — Number of workers used in parallel mode by grobid_process_files(). Default: 4L.

    OpenAlex matching — thresholds

    • oa_probable_threshold (numeric) — Global score threshold above which a candidate is considered as "probable". Default: 0.85.

    • oa_min_threshold (numeric) — Minimal threshold for including a candidate. Default: 0.60.

    • oa_doi_threshold (numeric) — Acceptance threshold for article matching via DOI. Default: 0.90.

    OpenAlex matching — weighting

    • oa_w_title (numeric) — Weight of the title in the global score. Default: 0.60.

    • oa_w_authors (numeric) — Weight of the authors in the global score. Default: 0.30.

    • oa_w_year (numeric) — Weight of the year in the global score. Default: 0.10.

    OpenAlex queries

    • oa_max_candidates (integer) — Maximum number of candidates presented per reference. Default: 3L.

    • oa_api_key (character or NA) — API key used for the OpenAlex "polite pool". Default: NA.

    OpenAlex matching — author analysis

    • oa_use_window (logical) — Enables a sliding window for author list analysis. Default: FALSE.

    • oa_window_size (numeric) — Size of the sliding window (±k). Default: 2.

    • oa_large_author_threshold (numeric) — Threshold from which an author list is considered "large". Default: 10.

    • oa_min_coverage_ratio (numeric) — Threshold distinguishing marginal truncation from massive truncation of the author list. Default: 0.65.

    • oa_author_lambda (numeric) — Penalty factor applied in case of truncation of the author list. Default: 0.4.

    • oa_sym_max_diff_abs (numeric) — Absolute tolerance applied in the symmetric case (similar number of authors). Default: 2.

    • oa_sym_max_diff_prop (numeric) — Proportional tolerance applied in the symmetric case. Default: 0.10.

    DOI validation

    • doi_email (character or NA) — Email used for the polite User-Agent when querying Crossref / doi.org. Default: NA.

    • doi_max_retries (integer) — Maximum number of attempts in case of network error or 5xx response for requests to doi.org. Default: 3L.

    • doi_retry_backoff (numeric) — Initial delay (in seconds) before a new attempt, doubled at each additional attempt (exponential backoff). Default: 1.

    Value

    Invisibly returns the updated internal environment (.checkrefr_env, an environment object).

    See also

    checkrefr_env_status() to view the currently configured values, checkrefr_env_reset() to reset these default values, grobid_check_requirements() and oa_matching_info() (OpenAlex matching parameters).

    Examples

    # Modify the default GROBID version used
checkrefr_set_defaults(grobid_version = "0.8.1")
#> ✔ Variable(s) updated: "grobid_version"

# Modify several variables simultaneously
checkrefr_set_defaults(timeout = 60L, max_workers = 2L)
#> ✔ Variable(s) updated: "timeout" and "max_workers"

# Adjust the OpenAlex matching thresholds and weights
checkrefr_set_defaults(
  oa_min_threshold = 0.55,
  oa_w_title       = 0.70,
  oa_w_authors     = 0.20,
  oa_w_year        = 0.10
)
#> ✔ Variable(s) updated: "oa_min_threshold", "oa_w_title", "oa_w_authors", and "oa_w_year"

# Add a priority remote URL for "full" mode
checkrefr_set_defaults(
  remote_default_url = list(full = list("1" = "https://mon-serveur.example.com"))
)
#> ✔ Variable(s) updated: "remote_default_url"

# Set an email for OpenAlex and Crossref polite requests
checkrefr_set_defaults(oa_api_key = "xxxXXxxyzZ", doi_email = "moi@example.com")
#> ✔ Variable(s) updated: "oa_api_key" and "doi_email"
